newsitem.title: USA: Possis says resolves Bard dispute.
newsitem.headline: Possis says resolves Bard dispute.

text.p: Possis Medical Inc said it settled a dispute with C.R. Bard Inc concerning their supply and distribution agreement for Possis' Perma-Seal dialysis access graft.
"Possis is now free to pursue other distribution options," the company said.
The settlement amount and additional terms were not disclosed, Possis said.
Possis, a medical devices maker, terminated its supply and distribution deal with Bard for the Perma-Seal in December.

Possis said Bard breached the agreement with Possis in August by purchasing IMPRA Inc, a supplier of synthetic vascular grafts and vascular access grafts for kidney dialysis patients. The acquisition presented a competitive conflict, Possis said.
